name: tokens
title: Semantic tokens
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: The color, type, space, shape and motion custom properties every block reads, with neutral defaults.

meta.useWhen: A project has no theme yet and you want one place to set colors, fonts, type scale, spacing and radius for every block.
meta.avoidWhen: The site already defines these roles, as every Site Boulder starter does. Keep the site's own tokens.

docs: Import src/styles/tokens.css once in your layout, then override the roles in your own theme. Blocks fall back to the same values, so this item is optional.
